name: viswa-pos
description: A simple, full-stack Point-of-Sale system with an owner dashboard, cashier billing interface, product management, and staff management.

scripts.start:frontend: set PORT=3002&& set GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false&& npm --prefix frontend start
scripts.db:health: node -e "import('./backend/src/database/prisma/schema-health.js').then(async (m) => { const result = await m.checkPrismaSchemaHealth(); console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)); process.exit(result.healthy ? 0 : 1); }).catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); });"
